provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled homogeneous canopy: at cumulative leaf-area coordinate l>=0,I(l)=I0*exp(-k*l). Net leaf assimilation a(I)=Pmax*I/(K+I)-Rd in micromol CO2per leaf m^2per s. Total canopy net assimilation per ground area is integral from0toLAIof a(I(l))dl. All response and extinction parameters are independently known; only observed LAI is inferred from transmission.
optimization: Separately maximize canopy net assimilation over all LAI>=0under this same fixed optical/leaf model. An added deep leaf layer contributes its own local a(I), not the top-leaf rate. Consider global behavior,not just a chosen grid.
scope: Controlled light-distribution/assimilation coupling, not observed field productivity, a planting prescription or a causal species comparison.
